correctness.rationale: The unordered-source-triple decomposition is exhaustive. Collision classes Z and M have exact indegree counts, the two-image case gives the signed center-position term, and the distinct-image invariant triples contribute only 3-fixed-point and 3-cycle corrections. Each conditional probability is determined by six internal orderings and outside label ranks; exact independently enumerated relabelings agree for every f on n=4,5 and sampled maps through n=8 (10,603 rational assertions). This is a proof for all n>=4, not an extrapolation from finite tests.

value.rationale: For a broad natural class of functional digraph observations, an apparently n-2-dimensional positional peak profile always lies on a 2-dimensional affine family, with its slope classified by two concrete merger motifs and its intercept by indegrees plus 1- and 3-cycles. Both slope signs occur. This is a structural classification of a nonbijective observation model, not a marginal expectation substitution or arbitrary finite numerical slice; it clarifies which graph features local order comparisons can detect.
